dependencyDashboardHeader:
This issue tracks every dependency Renovate knows about in `jmp-da`, plus any update it is holding back.

**Automatically managed** (built-in Renovate managers)
- `package.json` + `package-lock.json` - npm manager
- `.github/workflows/*.y*ml` - `github-actions` manager (action refs and `node-version` on `actions/setup-node`)

**Custom managed** (regex custom managers - see `customManagers` in `.renovaterc.json`)
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/<pkg>@<version>/...` in block and script source
- `https://esm.sh/<pkg>@<version>` in DA tool source
- `https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/<version>/...` in DA tool HTML

**Deliberately not managed**
- `plugins/**` - vendored copy of `adobe/aem-experimentation`; update by re-vendoring upstream
- `scripts/aem.js` - vendored from `adobe/aem-boilerplate`; no version marker to match on
- `https://da.live/nx/utils/sdk.js` - always-latest DA SDK, no version to pin
- `cinotify/github-action@main` - pinned to a branch rather than a tag; pin to a release tag to make it updatable
- Unversioned third-party embeds (VWO, New Relic, HubSpot, GTM, Vidyard, YouTube, Vimeo)

Updates are opt-in: everything is listed below and waits for a checkbox tick before Renovate opens a PR. Security fixes are the one exception and come through on their own.

Full inventory and rationale: `docs/renovate.md`

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh transitive pins in package-lock.json once a month.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes bypass the weekly schedule, the release-age hold, and the repo-wide dashboard gate.

packageRules.description: Major updates are opt-in. Renovate lists them on the dependency dashboard and only opens a PR once someone ticks the box.
npm - linting and formatting toolchain. Low blast radius; the Build workflow runs npm run lint on every push, which gates these PRs.
npm - unit test toolchain behind npm run unittest (@web/test-runner).
npm - visual regression toolchain behind npm run visual. Browser-engine bumps shift rendering, so expect to re-baseline test/screenshots when one of these merges.
npm - runtime dependencies of the scheduled event-processing workflows (scripts/post-event-processing.mjs).
GitHub Actions used by the Build, cleanup, index-config and post-event workflows.
Node.js version on actions/setup-node. A runtime change, so it is opt-in from the dashboard and the team picks the LTS line deliberately.

Everything found by the regex custom managers: version-pinned libraries loaded from a CDN at runtime. These are not in package-lock.json, so CI cannot catch a break - verify the affected page or tool renders before merging.
mathjax is pinned to a major-only range (@4) so jsDelivr keeps serving the latest v4 build. Replace strategy means Renovate stays quiet until v5 ships.
lit appears twice - as an npm devDependency and as the esm.sh import in tools/preflight-check. Group them so both versions move together and the drift stays visible.

customManagers.description: jsDelivr npm CDN pins - date-fns in blocks/listgroup-custom, mathjax in scripts/scripts.js, dompurify in scripts/search.js.
esm.sh CDN pins - lit in tools/preflight-check/preflight.js.

Google Hosted Libraries - jQuery in tools/search.html and tools/restore-version.html. Library path names on this CDN do not reliably match npm package names, so each one is mapped explicitly; add a manager here when a new library is introduced.
